text:
David Livingston posts support for Biggs as governor and comments on eliminations
By
B. S. MartinDavid Livingston, a Republican and member of the Arizona State House representing the 28th District since 2023, posted a series of tweets on July 15, 2026.
In his first tweet at 14:02 UTC, Livingston wrote: "ELIMINATED https://t.co/cZyaUTwwec".
Shortly after, at 14:04 UTC, he tweeted: "As Governor of Arizona BIGGS will Fight Fraud https://t.co/E3gxBRIuKU".
A minute later, at 14:04 UTC, Livingston added another post stating, "ELIMINATED https://t.co/de0Dm6dVml".
Livingston was elected to the Arizona State House in 2023 to represent the state's 28th House District. He succeeded Kelli Butler in this role.
